intro: Between 2026-04-16 and 2026-10-11, ZCyberNews covered ten Cisco stories spanning critical vulnerabilities and active exploitation. Interlock and The Gentlemen feature among the threat actors tracked across this tag. Five CVEs anchor the coverage: CVE-2026-20079, CVE-2026-20127, and CVE-2026-20182 each carry a CVSS score of 10, while CVE-2026-105278 and CVE-2026-76504 score 9.8. The severity mix comprises seven critical and two high findings. Enterprise networking, critical infrastructure, government, telecommunications, and energy rank among the affected sectors, with reporting touching the United states, Global, North america, Turkey, and UK.
